```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { dirname, join, relative, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'

const ROOT = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..')
const CONFIG_FILE = join(ROOT, '.vitepress', 'config.mts')

/**

 * nav/sidebar. Every entry is a decision, not an oversight.

const UNLINKED_ALLOWLIST = [
  'delivery-contract.md',
  'features/autonomous-agents.md',
  'features/channel-creator.md',
  'features/workspaces-container-routing-review.md',
  'features/workspaces-settings-scope-review.md',
]

function toPosix(p: string): string {
  return p.split('\\').join('/')
}

function internalLinks(): string[] {
  const source = readFileSync(CONFIG_FILE, 'utf8')
  const raw = [...source.matchAll(/link:\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g)].map((m) => m[1])
  return raw.filter((l) => !/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:/i.test(l) && !l.startsWith('#'))
}

function pageFileFor(link: string): string | null {
  const clean = link.split('#')[0].split('?')[0]
  const rel = clean.replace(/^\/+/, '').replace(/\/+$/, '')
  const candidates = rel === ''
    ? ['index.md']
    : [`${rel}.md`, `${rel}/index.md`]
  return candidates.find((c) => existsSync(join(ROOT, c))) ?? null
}

function markdownPages(dir = ROOT, acc: string[] = []): string[] {
  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (['node_modules', '.git', '.codx', '.vitepress', 'tmp', 'dist'].includes(entry.name)) continue
    const full = join(dir, entry.name)
    if (entry.isDirectory()) markdownPages(full, acc)
    else if (entry.name.endsWith('.md')) acc.push(toPosix(relative(ROOT, full)))
  }
  return acc
}
```
